datasets.dataset_source: single positive data set and 11 negative data sampling methods
datasets.evidence: We generated 660 predictive models using 12 machine learning architectures, a single positive data set and 11 negative data sampling methods.

important_evidence: AMPBenchmark web server created for benchmarking AMP prediction models.
Study demonstrates negative data sampling significantly biases model benchmarking.
660 models trained using 12 architectures and 11 negative sampling methods.
No new AMP prediction model clearly identified in this chunk, but AP_Sin model described in one paper (uncertain).
uncertainties: 综述（10.1007/s10989-025-10716-z）可能提及多个AMP预测模型，但无全文，需进一步验证具体模型名称和代码可用性。
AMPBenchmark使用的具体正数据集来源和11种负采样方法细节未知。
后两篇AMP设计研究未提出新的AMP预测模型，仅应用现有工具，其相关性需进一步确认。
